Ava (Product): Heads-up — we got a customer ask to support per-tenant routing + strict data isolation for their private deployment. Before I scope, need a quick alignment on sequencing and handoff owners. What needs to happen in runtime / infra / security and what are the non-negotiable launch gates?

Samir (ENG): Short answer: runtime + infra both need changes, security needs review. Can we list explicit tasks and an order? I can try to estimate if we break it down. :+1:

Jules (Runtime): Runtime work: 1) model routing policy plumbing (policy layer + routing table), 2) KV cache isolation per tenant (major perf risk), 3) perf testing with prefix/cache miss patterns. KV isolation probably adds ~2–3 sprint work for a senior eng + perf infra.

Priya (Infra): Infra items: network-level tenancy (VPC flow adjustments), disk sanitize for shared nodes, and capacity reservation config for Dedicated nodes. Lead time: provisioning capacity and validating autoscaler on Dedicated is ~3 weeks if we don't need new hardware. Also need docs for ops playbook.

Riley (Security): Security gates: design review for data-in-transit and at-rest separation, KMS key-per-tenant plan, threat model update for cross-tenant isolation, and final audit. The design review must be before any deploy to staging. Expect 1–2 week review cycle once design is ready.

Ava (Product): Good. Can we agree on a minimal launch gate checklist I can share with the customer? Suggest: a) routing correctness e2e tests, b) KV isolation verified under load, c) infra capacity reservation + failover tested, d) security design review signed off, e) documented rollback/fallback policy. Thoughts?

Samir (ENG): Agree. Add performance SLO smoke: p95 token latency under realistic load. Without that we risk regressions.

Jules (Runtime): Yep — also add a canary policy: route 5% traffic to the new per-tenant path with automatic fallback to shared model if latency/cost threshold exceeded. Sketch:```canary: {percent: 5, latency_threshold_ms: 300, fallback: shared-model}```

Priya (Infra): Ops checklist item: runbook for capacity shift + quick-switch DNS plan. And tagging capacity so billing maps to tenant.

Riley (Security): Plus, pre-launch penetration check scoped to isolation vectors. Not full pentest but targeted tests on tenant boundaries.

Samir (ENG): Owners proposal: Runtime owner = Jules, Infra owner = Priya, Security reviewer = Riley, PM = Ava, ENG ICs = Samir + 1 backend. Timeline estimate if we sequence in parallel: 6 weeks to staged canary (includes design review), +2 weeks to push to full.

Ava (Product): That timeline works as a baseline. Action items: 
- Jules: produce runtime design doc and perf risk notes by EOD Fri.
- Priya: validate capacity lead times and ops runbook outline by Mon.
- Riley: schedule design review slot next Wed.
- Samir: draft minimal e2e test matrix and canary policy language.

Jules (Runtime): Will do. I'll include benchmark targets and KV isolation microbenchmarks.

Priya (Infra): I'll confirm capacity windows and tag model.

Riley (Security): Added to calendar.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled for staging canary: 1951236200 — notify #eng-oncall 24h before. :robot_face:

Ava (Product): Thanks all — I'll send a short customer note with these gates and owners after we have the docs. :raised_hands:
